title: Sample Plate Filling 96 Wells to 384 Well Plate v2
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Attach P20 Multi‑Channel Pipette
steps.instruction: Ensure the P20 multi‑channel pipette is mounted on the OT‑2 robot before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Place PCR Mix in 96‑Well Plates
steps.instruction: Add the PCR mix to column A1 of each 96‑well elution plate (up to four plates). Each elution plate also contains a control that will be transferred.

steps.title: Load Labware on Deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the map: Plate 1 (96‑well elution) in slot 4 with its tip rack in slot 10; Plate 2 in slot 5 with tip rack in slot 11; Plate 3 in slot 1 with tip rack in slot 7; Plate 4 (if used) – slot not specified; load the 384‑well optical PCR plate in its designated slot as shown in the deck map.

steps.title: Configure Protocol Parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App customization fields, input the total number of samples across all plates (maximum 384) and indicate the number of 96‑well plates being used (1‑4). For runs with fewer than four plates, plan to add the missing controls manually later.

steps.title: Generate and Download Protocol
steps.instruction: After setting parameters, click “Generate” and download the resulting protocol file.

steps.title: Upload Protocol to OT‑App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑App.

steps.title: Calibrate Labware and Pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, calibrate each labware piece, tip rack, and the P20 pipette according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Run the Transfer Protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑App to start the automated transfer of PCR mix and samples from the 96‑well plates to the 384‑well plate.
